sloka: हन्त इदानीम् सकामा तु कैकेयी बान्धवैः सह ।ह्रियेयम् धर्म कामस्य धर्म पत्नी यशस्विनः ॥३-४९-२९॥
transliteration: hanta idānīm sakāmā tu kaikeyī bāndhavaiḥ saha ।hriyeyam dharma kāmasya dharma patnī yaśasvinaḥ ॥3-49-29॥

translations.english: Alas, the lawful wife of the glorious and righteous Rama is being abducted now. Let Kaikeyi along with her relations be happy with her desire fulfilled.
